name: Data Quality
description: Runs data quality checks over the input table in one combined aggregate statement and returns one row per check (output=long) or one summary row (output=summary): check, column, status, message, failed_rows, total_rows. Checks are not_null, unique, range, pattern, referential, row_count and allowed_values; fail_on decides whether a failed check aborts the run.

checks.title: Checks
checks.description: Checks to run, in output order; at least one is required.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: not_null - no NULLs; unique - no duplicated values; range - min/max bounds; pattern - regex search; referential - values exist in the Reference input; row_count - total row bounds; allowed_values - value domain.

column.title: Column
column.description: Column to check; required for every kind except row_count.

min.title: Minimum
min.description: Lower bound for range, or minimum row count for row_count.

max.title: Maximum
max.description: Upper bound for range, or maximum row count for row_count.

regex.title: Pattern
regex.description: RE2 regular expression (DuckDB regexp_matches) for the pattern kind.

values.title: Allowed values
values.description: Allowed value domain for the allowed_values kind.

fail_on.title: Fail on
fail_on.description: error - abort on failed error checks; warn - abort on any failed check; never - only report.

output.title: Output
output.description: long - one row per check; summary - one aggregated row.
